spells.name: Arcane Gate
spells.description: Create two linked teleportation portals (Large). One within range, one within 10ft. Portals are one-way rings. Entering one exits the other. Bonus Action to change facing.

spells.name: Blade Barrier
spells.description: Create wall of whirling blades (100ft line or 60ft ring). Provides Three-Quarters Cover and is Difficult Terrain. Entering or starting turn in wall: Dexterity save or 6d10 Force damage (half on success).

spells.name: Chain Lightning
spells.description: Lightning strikes a target and leaps to up to 3 others within 30ft. Each target makes a Dexterity save or takes 10d8 Lightning damage (half on success).
spells.upcast: Leaps to one additional target per level above 6.

spells.name: Circle of Death
spells.description: Negative energy in a 60ft-radius Sphere. Each creature makes a Constitution save or takes 8d6 Necrotic damage (half on success).
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 2d6 per level above 6.

spells.name: Conjure Fey
spells.description: Conjure Medium spirit. Melee spell attack on appearance: 3d12 + spellcasting modifier Psychic damage and Frightened until your next turn. Bonus Action: teleport spirit 30ft and repeat attack.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d12 per level above 6.

spells.name: Contingency
spells.description: Cast a spell (L5-, 1 Action, targets you) to be triggered by a specific circumstance. Triggered spell takes effect immediately and only targets you.

spells.name: Create Undead
spells.description: Cast only at night. Turn up to three corpses (S/M Humanoid) into Ghouls. Command as a Bonus Action (120ft). Control lasts 24 hours.
spells.upcast: L7: 4 Ghouls; L8: 5 Ghouls or 2 Ghasts/Wights; L9: 6 Ghouls or 3 Ghasts/Wights or 2 Mummies.

spells.name: Dirge
spells.description: Mournful song in 60ft Emanation. Enemies make a Constitution save. Fail: 2d6 Psychic damage, Prone, and half Speed. Success: half damage and half Speed until your next turn.

spells.name: Disintegrate
spells.description: Green ray forces a Dexterity save. Fail: 10d6 + 40 Force damage. If HP reaches 0, target is reduced to dust. Destroys Large- nonmagical objects/force effects automatically.
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 3d6 per level above 6.

spells.name: Drawmij's Instant Summons
spells.description: Mark object (max 10 lbs, 6ft). Magic Action: crush sapphire to recall item to hand from any distance. If held by another, learn their identity/location.

spells.name: Eyebite
spells.description: Eyes become void. One creature within 60ft makes a Wisdom save. Fail: choose Asleep (Unconscious), Panicked (Frightened + Dash away), or Sickened (Poisoned). Action to repeat on new target.

spells.name: Find the Path
spells.description: Sense shortest, safest physical route to a named fixed location on your plane.

spells.name: Flesh to Stone
spells.description: Target makes a Constitution save. Fail: Restrained. Success: 0 Speed until next turn. Restrained target repeats save; 3 fails = Petrified, 3 successes = ends.

spells.name: Forbiddance
spells.description: Ward 40k sq ft area (30ft high) against planar travel. Chosen creature types (Celestials, Fiends, etc.) take 5d10 Radiant/Necrotic damage when entering/starting turn. Permanent if cast daily for 30 days.

spells.name: Globe of Invulnerability
spells.description: 10ft Emanation shimmering barrier. Spells of L5- cast outside cannot affect anything inside.
spells.upcast: Barrier blocks spells up to one level lower than slot used.

spells.name: Guards and Wards
spells.description: Ward 2.5k sq ft area. Includes: fog corridors, locked doors, web stairs, and choice of: Dancing Lights, Magic Mouth, or Stinking Cloud effects.

spells.name: Harm
spells.description: Unleash disease. Target makes a Constitution save. Fail: 14d6 Necrotic damage and HP max reduced by same amount for 1 hour. Success: half damage and no reduction. Cannot reduce HP below 1.

spells.name: Heal
spells.description: Target regains 70 HP. Ends Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned conditions. No effect on Undead/Constructs.
spells.upcast: Healing increases by 10 per level above 6.

spells.name: Heroes' Feast
spells.description: Create feast for 12. Consuming takes 1h. Benefits (24h): HP max +2d10 (and heal same), Resistance to Poison, Immunity to Frightened/Poisoned, Adv on Wis saves.

spells.name: Leomund's Lamentable Belaborment
spells.description: Proclaim inflammatory statement. Creatures in 10ft-radius Sphere make an Intelligence save. Fail: Charmed; must argue for/against statement. Target has 0 Speed and is Blinded/Deafened to others.

spells.name: Magic Jar
spells.description: Soul enters container; body catatonic. Possess Humanoid within 100ft (Charisma save). Use target physical stats; alignment/mental scores stay yours. If container/body destroyed, you might die.

spells.name: Mass Suggestion
spells.description: Suggest reasonable course of action to up to 12 creatures. Each makes a Wisdom save. Fail: target follows suggestion for duration or until completed.

spells.name: Move Earth
spells.description: Reshape dirt, sand, or clay in a 40ft square area. Raise/lower elevation, create trenches/pillars. Cannot move stone.

spells.name: Otiluke's Freezing Sphere
spells.description: Globe of cold explodes in 60ft-radius Sphere. Each creature makes a Constitution save or takes 10d6 Cold damage (half on success). Freezes water (30ft sq, 6in deep).
spells.upcast: Damage increases by 1d6 per level above 6.

spells.name: Otto's Irresistible Dance
spells.description: Target makes a Wisdom save. Success: dances comically (spends all movement) for 1 turn. Fail: Charmed; dances for duration, Disadv on Dex saves/attacks, others have Adv on attacks vs it.

spells.name: Planar Ally
spells.description: Beseech entity for aid. Celestial/Elemental/Fiend appears. Negotiate payment (e.g., 100gp/min or 1k/day) for a task.

spells.name: Programmed Illusion
spells.description: Create illusion that activates on a trigger. Performs for 5 mins then goes dormant until triggered again. Includes sound/light/temp.

spells.name: Summon Fiend
spells.description: Summon Fiendish spirit (Demon, Devil, or Yugoloth). Shares Initiative (acts after you). Obeys commands. Stat block scales with level.
spells.upcast: Stat block scales with spell level.

spells.name: Sunbeam
spells.description: 60ft long, 5ft wide Line of light. Each creature makes a Constitution save. Fail: 6d8 Radiant damage and Blinded until start of your next turn. Success: half damage only. Use a Magic action each turn to repeat.

spells.name: Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron
spells.description: Conjure cauldron duplicating properties of a Common/Uncommon potion. Bonus Action to withdraw. Produces potions = spellcasting modifier. Potions vanish when spell ends.

spells.name: Transport via Plants
spells.description: Create a magical link between a Large- inanimate plant and another you've seen on the same plane. Creatures can step into one and exit the other by spending 5ft movement.

spells.name: True Seeing
spells.description: Touch a willing creature to grant it 120ft Truesight and ability to see secret doors and into the Ethereal Plane.

spells.name: Wall of Ice
spells.description: Create continguous ice wall (dome radius 10ft or ten 10x10ft panels). Placement: Dexterity save or 10d6 Cold damage. Breaching: AC 12, 30 HP per panel; leaves frigid air (Con save or 5d6 Cold damage).
spells.upcast: Damage increases: +2d6 initial, +1d6 frigid air per level above 6.

spells.name: Wall of Thorns
spells.description: Create thorny wall (60ft long or 20ft ring). Blocks line of sight. Movement cost 4:1. Dexterity save or take 7d8 Piercing damage when it appears. Entering or starting turn in wall: Dexterity save or 7d8 Slashing damage.
spells.upcast: Both damages increase by 1d8 per level above 6.

spells.name: Wind Walk
spells.description: Up to ten willing creatures assume cloud form (300ft Fly Speed, hover, Resistance to physical damage). Actions restricted to Dash or Magic Action to revert (takes 1 min; Stunned). Can return to cloud form with a Magic action + 1 min.

spells.name: Word of Recall
spells.description: You and up to five willing creatures within 5ft instantly teleport to a previously designated sanctuary on the same plane. Sanctuary must be designated by casting this spell there first.

spells.name: Bones of the Earth
spells.description: Up to 6 stone pillars (5ft dia, 30ft high; AC 5, 30 HP) burst from ground. Under creature: Dexterity save or lifted. If blocked by ceiling: 6d6 Bludgeoning damage and Restrained (Action Str/Dex check to free). Rubble is Difficult Terrain.
spells.upcast: Create two additional pillars for each level above 6.

spells.name: Create Homunculus
spells.description: Take 2d4 irreducible Piercing damage to create a Homunculus companion (HP max + your level). Telepathic link within 1,000ft; see/hear through senses (Action). Spend Hit Dice to increase its HP max (lasts until Long Rest).

companion_stats.name: Homunculus
companion_stats.note: See Monster Manual; HP max scales.

spells.name: Druid Grove
spells.description: Ward 30-90ft Cube. Effects: Solid Fog (Heavily Obscured + 3:1 movement), Grasping Undergrowth (Entangle), 4 Grove Guardians (Awakened Trees), and choice of: Gust of Wind (2), Spike Growth (1), or Wind Wall (2). Permanent if cast daily for 1 year.

spells.name: Fizban's Platinum Shield
spells.description: Silvery field (5ft radius) grants Half Cover, Resistance (Acid/Cold/Fire/Lightning/Poison), and Evasion. Bonus Action to move to another creature within 60ft.

spells.name: Investiture of Flame
spells.description: Immune to Fire, Resistance to Cold. 5ft aura deals 1d10 Fire damage. Action: create 15x5ft line of fire (Dex save or 4d8 Fire damage, half on success). Sheds 30ft Bright (+30ft Dim) light.

spells.name: Investiture of Ice
spells.description: Immune to Cold, Resistance to Fire. Ignore ice/snow Difficult Terrain. 10ft radius is Difficult Terrain for others. Action: 15ft cone of wind (Con save or 4d6 Cold damage + half Speed until next turn; half damage on success).

spells.name: Investiture of Stone
spells.description: Resistance to nonmagical physical damage. Ignore earth/stone Difficult Terrain; move through solid earth/stone (cannot end turn inside). Action: small earthquake (15ft radius, Dex save or Prone).

spells.name: Investiture of Wind
spells.description: Ranged weapon attacks against you have Disadvantage. 60ft Fly Speed. Action: 15ft cube of wind (within 60ft). Con save or 2d10 Bludgeoning damage + pushed 10ft. Success: half damage.

spells.name: Mental Prison
spells.description: Force Intelligence save (auto-success if immune to Charmed). Hit: 5d10 Psychic damage. Fail: Restrained and Blinded/Deafened to outside world. If it moves/attacks through illusion: 10d10 Psychic damage and spell ends.

spells.name: Primordial Ward
spells.description: Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, and Thunder. Reaction when taking such damage: gain Immunity to that type until end of your next turn, then spell ends.

spells.name: Scatter
spells.description: Teleport yourself and/or up to five willing creatures (or unwilling S/M creatures making a Wisdom save) to unoccupied spaces you can see within 120ft. Surface must support targets.

spells.name: Soul Cage
spells.description: Reaction when Humanoid dies within 60ft. Trap soul (max 6 uses): **Steal Life** (heal 2d8), **Query Soul** (brief truthful answer), **Borrow Experience** (Advantage on next roll), or **Eyes of the Dead** (scry sensor where they lived).

spells.name: Tasha's Otherworldly Guise
spells.description: Transform. Lower Plane: Immune to Fire/Poison/Poisoned. Upper Plane: Immune to Radiant/Necrotic/Charmed. Both: 40ft Fly Speed, +2 AC, magical weapon attacks (use spell modifier), and Extra Attack (2).

spells.name: Tenser's Transformation
spells.description: Endow martial prowess: 50 Temp HP, Advantage on weapon attacks, +2d12 Force damage on hit, proficiency in all armor/shields/weapons and Str/Con saves, Extra Attack (2). Cannot cast spells. Ends: DC 15 Con save or 1 level Exhaustion.
